description: This file defines a fake implementation of the CalendarAccountEventFactory used for testing purposes within the CalendarSync module of SuiteCRM. It provides in-memory creation of CalendarAccountEvent objects from beans like Meeting, Call, and Task, avoiding database interactions. It also includes methods to clone from existing CalendarAccountEvent objects.

classes.name: FakeCalendarAccountEventFactory
classes.description: A test double extending CalendarAccountEventFactory that creates CalendarAccountEvent instances from in-memory bean data without database access.
